title: Lensworks — Optical Bench Studio
description: Build a real optical system from lenses, mirrors and prisms, trace white light through it, and measure what you designed.
concept: A 2D non-sequential ray tracer on a 440 mm optical bench. Every element expands into spherical arcs and flat segments; rays march forward taking the nearest surface ahead, so cemented doublets, folded periscopes, prism dispersion and total internal reflection all fall out of one loop. Glasses carry a real Cauchy dispersion derived from nd and the Abbe number, so white light splits into eight wavelengths and chromatic focus shift is measured, not faked. The analysis side reports RMS spot size, spot extent, paraxial focal length and back focus, draws a through-focus curve, and will drive the sensor to best focus for you.
features: Five element types — lens, mirror, prism, stop and a pass-through sensor plane — added, dragged and tuned live
Two source modes (collimated beam, point fan) with 1 or 3 fields, field angle, and a white-light toggle that traces eight wavelengths
Real dispersion: seven glasses with nd + Abbe number driving a Cauchy index, so flint spreads colour four times wider than crown
Analysis bench: RMS spot, spot extent, paraxial EFL, back focus, spot profile, through-focus curve and one-click auto-focus
Eight worked presets from a chromatic singlet to an achromatic doublet, Keplerian telescope, prism spectrometer and periscope fold
Export the bench as PNG, the ray diagram as SVG, and the full prescription plus measurements as JSON
Share the whole bench in the URL hash, autosave to localStorage, and keep a named library of benches

interaction.mouse: Drag any element along the bench; drag empty space to pan; scroll to zoom
interaction.click: Click an element (on the bench or in the list) to select and reveal its sliders
interaction.touch: One finger drags elements or pans, two fingers pinch to zoom; the panel becomes a tabbed sheet
interaction.keyboard: 1–8 load presets, F auto-focuses the sensor, W toggles white light, arrows nudge the selection, Delete removes it
